# `swarm_msg`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] swarm_msg`

Send a short message to another swarm worker (`to` = worker-N), the parent agent (`parent`), or every sibling (`all`). Use when your work affects someone else. Not a chat — one or two sentences.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | Message body |
| `to` | string | yes | Recipient: parent \| all \| worker-N |
